description: Get list of all roles with their permissions

includeUserCount.description: Include count of users assigned to each role

sql: SELECT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.description, r.is_system, r.priority, r.created_date, r.created_by, r.last_modified_date, r.last_modified_by, CASE WHEN {{includePermissions}} = true THEN LISTAGG(p.permission_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.permission_name) ELSE NULL END AS permissions, CASE WHEN {{includeUserCount}} = true THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) FROM {{userRolesTable}} ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.role_id) ELSE NULL END AS user_count FROM {{rolesTable}} r LEFT JOIN {{rolePermissionsTable}} rp ON r.role_id = rp.role_id AND {{includePermissions}} = true LEFT JOIN {{permissionsTable}} p ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id AND {{includePermissions}} = true WHERE ({{systemOnly}} = false OR r.is_system = true) GROUP BY r.role_id, r.role_name, r.description, r.is_system, r.priority, r.created_date, r.created_by, r.last_modified_date, r.last_modified_by ORDER BY r.priority DESC, r.role_name
